image_description: A single Australian Pelican (Pelecanus conspicillatus) floating on calm, greyish water. The bird is shown in profile facing left, with its characteristic long, pale pinkish-orange bill dipping slightly towards the water surface. It has white plumage on the head, neck, and chest, contrasting with black flight feathers on the wings and back. A clear reflection of the pelican is visible in the water below.
